title: Whole-Chip Tetris
module: whole chip (all 1,329 synthesized cells: datapath, divider, controller, SPI/config), netlist wc_ref2 = c06 + c09
summary: Every synthesized cell of the chip is placed together, starting from the tool's own placement, and handed to the flow FIXED with the r32 handoff: steps 17-32 run as in the reference, so repair and upsizing still happen at the tool's GPL positions, and the placement is fixed right after RepairDesignPostGPL (LibreLane meta.substituting_steps). This handoff reproduces wc_ref2 exactly, with zero FIRM penalty; FIRM at step 17 costs +61.5 to +74.7. With repair fixed, the area lever is the clock tree. CTS pads every leaf whose clock-pin cap is below its subtree's largest leaf with a dummy load, so the dummy area depends only on how the flops are clustered. A greedy search with the real CTS in the loop chose the flop set: the tool's final flop positions plus one relocation of _2062_. A chip-wide anneal of the 1,007 non-flop cells, weighted by repair and criticality, then cut slew violations. Winner ga1 signs off at 43,394.7 um2, 35.1 below wc_ref2, all of it CTS.

decision.label: Winner ga1: -35.1 um2 (CTS), slew 146 -> 115, signoff = dry run
decision.text: ga1 signs off at 43,394.7 um2 against wc_ref2's 43,429.8 (-35.1). Slew/cap/fanout is 115/1/0 against 146/1/0, setup +40.03 ns, hold +0.065 ns (wc_ref2 +0.081), route DRC 0, Magic DRC 0, LVS 0, antenna 0, and the netlist is identical to wc_ref2's. The gain is entirely the clock tree: 777.1 against 812.2, the same 3 clkbuf_8 and 17 leaf clkbuf_4, with leaf dummies inv_4 x2 + inv_3 replacing clkinv_4 x2 + inv_4 + a clkbuf_4. Repair (746.4) and upsizing (289.8, the same 28 cells) are identical by construction. Robustness: two re-annealed variants (41 and 46 cells moved, no flops) give the same 43,394.7, and every one of the 12 non-flop anneals on the two chosen flop sets lands on its set's area. A variant whose flops were disturbed falls back to -21.9: the CTS part of the gain is sensitive to flop moves. Losers: FIRM at step 17 (+30.8 to +74.7), letting the wire annealer move flops (-13.1 / -17.5 only), and compaction (no area change; density converges at 84.0-84.1%).

runs.label: ga1: tool final placement + 1 CTS flop relocation + chip-wide weighted anneal, r32 handoff
runs.note: All 1,329 synthesized cells FIXED via MACRO_PLACEMENT_CFG applied after RepairDesignPostGPL; 28 upsizes decided at step 32 placed at their step-32 masters; netlist sha256 f2e8ad437dde2946... = wc_ref2.

verification: Placement only: the synthesized netlist sha256 equals wc_ref2's (f2e8ad437dde2946...); LVS 0 against it; manufacturability report: antenna, LVS and DRC passed.
Validator scripts/validate.py --regen on ga1, ga1_p1, ga1_p2: regenerated placement byte-identical, views agree, geometry legal, planted overlap rejected (logs/validate_ga1.txt).
check_held_run.py: all 1,329 cells FIXED at their configured origin and orientation at all 10 step DEFs, from ManualMacroPlacement to final (logs/check_held_wc_ga1.json).
The r32 handoff was checked on its own: the tool placement handed off this way reproduces wc_ref2 exactly, in both the dry run (wc_work/s34_r32) and a full harden (wc_r32mech, 43,429.8).
The dry run (wc_work/ga1_r32) and the signoff harden agree exactly on area, slew/cap/fanout, setup, hold and wire length.
Robustness: ga1_p1 and ga1_p2 give 43,394.7 with 133/1/0 and 129/1/0, hold >= 0 at all 9 corners; the flop-disturbed ga1_j1 gives 43,407.9.
